headline: Iranian hackers breach US water and energy grids amid Middle East escalations
subheadline: Iranian cyberoperations targeted US water systems and energy grids, exploiting vulnerable internet-connected equipment to create persistent security risks across critical infrastructure
lede: Hamas carried out a coordinated strike in the Gaza Strip, killing two operatives including commander Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi and Momen Saeed Mohammed Al‑Hawari, prompting an IDF response to Hezbollah rocket fire on Mount Tabor. Israeli forces continued demolishing tunnel networks in northern Gaza, destroying over 26 kilometers of underground tunnels since the October 2025 ceasefire, while Iranian state‑sponsored hackers breached US water management systems and energy grids via vulnerable internet‑connected equipment. In the Ukraine‑Russia war, Russian airstrikes on Kyiv and Odesa damaged residential buildings, a medical facility, and schools, causing multiple civilian casualties including a child, and Ukrainian forces destroyed a Ka‑27 helicopter and a MiG‑29 aircraft inside Russian territory. Hezbollah launched two missiles toward Nevatim, triggering IDF rapid response interceptions with zero Israeli casualties, and a shootout between GUR and SBU forces erupted in Kyiv over the kidnapping of a Russian Volunteer Corps deputy.

sections.title: Russian strikes hit Kyiv and Odesa
sections.body: Russian airstrikes on Kyiv damaged a six‑story residential building in Shevchenkivskyi district and a medical facility in Holosiyivskyi district, igniting a fire at an educational facility and causing four civilian casualties. A mass attack on Odesa overnight killed eight people, including a child, destroyed a multi‑story building and two schools, and left part of the city without power. Ukrainian forces struck back, destroying a Russian Ka‑27 helicopter near Yessk airfield in Krasnodar Krai and a MiG‑29 aircraft near Millerovo airfield in Rostov region. Additional drone and sea‑drone assaults targeted infrastructure across Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Vinnytsia, and Odesa regions, while a shootout between GUR and SBU forces on Shumsky Street in Kyiv followed the kidnapping of Stepan Kaplunov, deputy commander of the Russian Volunteer Corps.

sections.title: Hamas strike triggers IDF‑Hezbollah exchange in northern Gaza
sections.body: Hamas conducted a coordinated strike in the Gaza Strip, killing commander Talal Mustafa Saleh Badawi and operative Momen Saeed Mohammed Al‑Hawari, marking a notable escalation in northern Gaza operations. Israeli forces continued a tunnel demolition campaign, destroying over 26 kilometers of underground tunnels along the Gaza ceasefire line, degrading Hamas infiltration routes. Hezbollah fired two projectiles toward Nevatim, prompting immediate IDF defensive actions and rapid response interceptions with zero Israeli casualties. Iranian state‑sponsored hackers breached US water management systems and energy grids, exploiting vulnerable internet‑connected equipment to create persistent security risks.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data reveals a multi‑domain Iranian threat combining cyber intrusions against US critical infrastructure with support for proxy attacks across the Middle East, while Russia escalates strikes on Ukrainian civilian infrastructure despite Ukrainian counter‑strikes deep inside Russian territory. Hezbollah’s repeated missile exchanges and Hamas’s targeted killings indicate persistent cross‑border aggression aimed at destabilizing Israeli security perimeters, suggesting ongoing offensive capabilities despite sanctions and ceasefire agreements.
